parole.significato: money, food, or other provisions taken to school, work, or on a journey.
A brushy, rural area or location.
parole.testo: 1910s during or around the Philippine–American War after the Spanish–American War, from Tagalog bundok (“mountain”), adopted by occupying American soldiers serving in the mountains or rural countryside of the American-occupied Philippines under the United States Military Government of the Philippine
